questions.badPrompt: Make an advertisement for a college fest.
questions.context: An upcoming 3-day inter-college technical and cultural festival.
missingElements: Target audience demographics (age, student interests)
Tone and brand personality (youthful, energetic, cyber)
Platform format (video script, Instagram reel, poster copy)
Key attractions and call to action (registration dates, website)
Constraints (duration, character count, scene directions)

questions.badPrompt: Write a story about an AI taking over a coffee shop.
missingElements: Main characters & protagonist perspective (barista vs robotic manager)
Pacing and narrative arc (inciting incident, climax, humorous resolution)
Humor style and dialogue formatting
Word limit and scene formatting specifications

questions.badPrompt: Create a social media video about plastic pollution.
questions.context: A viral public-awareness campaign for Gen Z audiences on Instagram and TikTok.
missingElements: Hook within the first 3 seconds to prevent drop-off
Visual storytelling scene transitions and camera angles
BGM and sound design cues
Actionable consumer lifestyle change CTA

questions.badPrompt: Write a sci-fi movie trailer voiceover.
questions.context: A dramatic theatrical trailer for a post-apocalyptic solar flare survival thriller.
missingElements: Pacing milestones (0-15s Tease, 15-45s Escalation, 45-60s Climax)
Cinematic SFX and orchestral cue markers [BASS DROP, GLITCH]
Deep, gravelly narrator voice persona guidelines
Final title card lockup and release date reveal

questions.context: A premium noise-cancelling smart headphone designed for software developers & remote workers.
missingElements: Product details and unique selling proposition (USP)
Ideal customer profile (ICP) and acoustic pain points
Marketing copywriting framework (AIDA or PAS)
Pricing tier, objection handling, and conversion CTA
Delivery format (landing page copy, cold email, sales deck)

questions.badPrompt: Write a launch strategy for an app.
questions.context: A peer-to-peer campus ride-sharing and carpool app.
missingElements: Target geography and rollout phases (Closed Beta vs Campus Blitz)
User acquisition channels (guerrilla marketing, campus ambassadors)
Budget constraints and 30-day timeline breakdown
Key performance indicators (CAC, LTV, Daily Active Riders)

questions.badPrompt: Write an email to win back churning customers.
questions.context: A B2B SaaS analytics platform addressing canceled pro-tier accounts.
missingElements: Customer segmentation (usage drop vs pricing friction)
Empathetic, non-defensive executive tone
Specific value-reinforcement and feature update highlights
Tailored discount/extension incentive with a frictionless 1-click reactivation link

questions.badPrompt: Create a pitch deck script for investors.
questions.context: An early-stage climate-tech startup seeking $1.5M Seed funding for solar recycling tech.
missingElements: Standard 10-slide venture narrative structure (Problem, TAM, Solution, Unit Economics, Moat)
Explicit financial traction metrics and IP patents
Direct competitor matrix with unfair advantage
Specific capital allocation breakdown (R&D vs Commercialization)

questions.context: Quarterly e-commerce revenue figures across 4 regions with sudden Q3 drop.
missingElements: Specific analytical goals (anomaly detection, MoM growth, profit margins)
Required statistical metrics and calculations
Output format (markdown summary table, executive bullet points, chart recommendations)
Target audience (board of directors vs operational managers)
Actionable recommendations based on insights

questions.context: Comparing Tesla Model 3 and Hyundai Ioniq 5 for corporate fleet procurement.
missingElements: Comparison criteria (battery efficiency, TCO, maintenance, charging curve)
Evaluation methodology and scoring weightage
Structured comparison matrix/table
Executive recommendation with 5-year ROI justification

questions.badPrompt: Summarize this hospital patient readmission data.
questions.context: A 12-month post-operative dataset across 5,000 patients to identify high-risk re-admissions.
missingElements: Demographic and comorbidity risk-stratification parameters
Statistical correlation methods (odds ratios, p-values)
Structured clinical findings table with confidence intervals
Operational triage protocol recommendations for nursing staff

questions.badPrompt: Find fraud patterns in credit card transactions.
questions.context: A synthetic dataset of 100,000 transactions with anomalous cross-border micropayments.
missingElements: Fraud detection heuristic rules (velocity checks, IP geolocation mismatches, amount thresholds)
False-positive vs false-negative tolerance thresholds
Incident severity classification schema (Low, Medium, Critical)
Structured markdown alert schema with recommended block/flag actions

questions.context: Organizing a 24-hour national hackathon with 500 participants on a tight budget.
missingElements: Event scope, theme, and timeline breakdown (T-minus milestones)
Budget limits, sponsorship deliverables, and volunteer shifts
Risk mitigation & contingency plans (power outage, food catering, WiFi failure)
Judging criteria and participant deliverables
Structured master operational schedule

questions.context: Severe vehicle congestion and lack of two-wheeler slots during morning peak hours.
missingElements: Stakeholder analysis (students, faculty, administrative staff)
Short-term operational fixes vs long-term infrastructural solutions
Enforcement and incentive mechanisms (digital passes, carpool zoning)
Phased implementation roadmap and measurable congestion KPIs

questions.context: A university campus dining hall generating 300kg of organic food waste daily.
missingElements: Supply chain & portioning audit methodology
Surplus redistribution protocols with local food banks/shelters
On-campus composting and bio-gas conversion feasibility metrics
Student incentive programs and measurable weekly audit targets

questions.badPrompt: Set up a student mental health peer-support network.
questions.context: Creating a confidential, student-led psychological wellness initiative on campus.
missingElements: Volunteer screening and psychological first-aid training framework
Confidentiality safeguards and data privacy protocols
Emergency escalation pathways to licensed clinical professionals
Awareness outreach strategy to destigmatize help-seeking
